info.title: InvoiceFlow API
info.description: Hand-maintained subset used by the web client; keep in sync with InvoicesController.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Repeat to match any of several statuses. Cancelled invoices are listed only when asked for.

parameters.name: overdue
parameters.description: Only approved invoices whose due date has passed.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Part of the supplier name or invoice number.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: uploadedAt, invoiceDate, dueDate, totalAmount, status or supplierName; a leading - sorts descending. Default -uploadedAt.
